body: ACCEPTED BLOCK: the review is correct. My rejection helper preserved foreign cache/policy vectors despite the stated preserve-only-calls law. I have changed the API so rejectProviderResult cannot accept those vectors, conforming rejection now carries only ProviderCalls, and cache rejection rebuilds only wrapper-owned cache decisions and denials. Canary foreign cache/policy probes are added on both paths. Focused x3 gate running next; I will amend the candidate SHA and rerun exact-tip full court before requesting review again.
